wholePhysicalScope: Named OpenStreetMap way 100080986 (Q2296514) identifies 22 distinct corners of the cathedral footprint. The 2018 cathedral vicar’s survey establishes the 75 m length and 32 m transept width.
lodDetails: Four levels retain the twin square bell towers, nave, transept and dome. Near levels show paired porch columns, rose tracery and ornament.
limitations: The main footprint follows the current mapped perimeter. Tower, roof, dome and side-aisle heights, individual stone ornaments and some façade details are approximate.
The façade includes geometric interpretations of the stained glass and mosaic. The model excludes interiors, adjacent buildings and individual carved figures.
